answer: Sybil resistance rests on proof-of-cost staking, not identity checks. Each agent posts a bond locked for an epoch, and each attestation is weighted by that bond, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand separate bonds. An attacker who splinters capital is like a river split into rubble: every small channel still carries the full lock. Standing is grown from a vine of verified peer attestations, so a fresh clone starts leafless. Open peer grading slashes bonds of mass-rejected attestations, draining value toward a sink like the ocean.
